text:
joel: FYI I'm drafting the relnotes for the embeddings behavioral change — prefix caching now skips single-token queries by default. putting a short migration snippet here, want quick eyes before I post :eyes:

maria-docs: thanks — can you paste the exact code snippet you'll publish? need to verify SDK examples align with new client v0.11

joel: sure. short snippet for JS SDK:
```js
// migrate: ensure you set `prefixCaching: true` and `minTokens: 2`
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'open-embed-123',
  input: ['a', 'two token'],
  options: { prefixCaching: true, minTokens: 2 }
});
```

sam-engineering: quick note — our runtime still treats empty strings as special-case; add a callout in known-issues that empty input will return 400 from runtime v1.4.2

maria-docs: good catch. also add an example for Python and a short migration checklist: change default, check tests that assert token counts, QA for edge-case prompts.

joel: ok adding python snippet and known-issue blurb. python snippet:
```py
# migrate: set min_tokens to avoid single-token drop
resp = client.embeddings.create(
    model='open-embed-123',
    input=['a', 'two token'],
    options={'prefix_caching': True, 'min_tokens': 2}
)
```

tiago: tiny nit: prefer snake_case in examples for python but keep camelCase in JS. Also include a short test snippet using the eval harness so customers can repro.

joel: will add test snippet and a migration checklist in the relnote: 1) update SDK usage 2) run unit tests 3) inspect historic embeddings pipeline for single-token outliers 4) pin runtime >= v1.4.2 if relying on empty-string behavior

alex: for docs site link fixes — can you add the internal API link to the model catalog where we describe `open-embed-123`? broken link reported by Support ticket #7891.

maria-docs: noted. joel, also we should mention the Canary behavior: Dedicated customers on the canary pool see the old behavior until next week — add a line under rollout and known issues.

joel: added. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7042 — contains snippets, known-issues, and a small redirect for the catalog anchor.

sam-engineering: looks fine from runtime POV. can we add a short perf note: enabling prefix caching reduces tokens served by ~12% on our sampled workloads? gives customers a reason to flip. :+1:

maria-docs: love that. include the perf stat and a link to the infra benchmark: https://internal.redwood/bench/emb-2026 (internal)

deploy-bot: joel pushed branch joel/emb-relnotes -> staging/docs (CI: passing) :white_check_mark:

joel: thanks all. i'll merge after one more reviewer and then schedule the relnote publish for Tue morning. tagging @maria-docs for final proof. :tada:

maria-docs: happy to proof tomorrow AM. small wording request: change 'single-token' -> 'inputs under token length 2' for clarity.

joel: done in PR. merging after green build.

alex: after publish can we post a short blurb in #product and #support summarizing the migration steps? I can draft the support template.

maria-docs: yes pls. I'll add a one-paragraph summary and the support template to the PR description.

joel: perfect. closing thread — will update with the actual publish timestamp once live.
